edges.description: Holds the power to appoint all members of the board of OpenAI Group PBC.
Described as OpenAI's largest outside investor.
Stated as chief executive of OpenAI.
OpenAI Group PBC is the public benefit corporation under the OpenAI name; the source states it is a public benefit corporation.
Under the restructured agreement, Microsoft holds a stake of about 27% in OpenAI Group PBC.
Satya Nadella is chief executive of Microsoft.
OpenAI depends on Microsoft's Azure cloud for most of its computing power.
The source refers to Microsoft's Azure cloud.
Microsoft has exclusive rights to sell OpenAI models through Azure until 2032.
Azure is a Microsoft product line, as implied by the source reporting Microsoft's quarter with Azure revenue.

sources.title: Microsoft and OpenAI rework partnership
sources.content: Microsoft has invested roughly $13 billion in OpenAI since 2019. Under the restructured agreement, Microsoft holds a stake of about 27% in OpenAI Group PBC. The OpenAI Foundation, a nonprofit, retains control of the company and appoints its board. Satya Nadella, chief executive of Microsoft, said the partnership remains strong.

sources.title: OpenAI Group PBC: governance summary
sources.content: OpenAI Group PBC is a public benefit corporation. The OpenAI Foundation holds the power to appoint all members of the board of directors of OpenAI Group PBC. Microsoft, OpenAI's largest outside investor, does not have a board seat and does not control OpenAI. Sam Altman is chief executive of OpenAI.

sources.title: Opinion: Microsoft is really in charge
sources.content: OpenAI depends on Microsoft's Azure cloud for most of its computing power. Critics argue that Microsoft has effective control over OpenAI's strategy because of this dependence. Microsoft has exclusive rights to sell OpenAI models through Azure until 2032.

sources.title: Azure growth beats estimates
sources.content: Microsoft reported quarterly revenue of $77.7 billion. Azure revenue grew 40%, led by AI services.
